description: Make Christmas Eve extra special with these festive and fun Christmas Eve Box! Featuring brightly coloured designs and a built-in handle for easy carrying, it’s perfect for holding treats, small gifts, or holiday surprises. Each box includes a sheet of alphabetical stickers so you can personalise it with a name - making it a magical keepsake. Crafted from durable card with a laminated gloss finish, it’s both sturdy and eye-catching. Assembly required. Approx size: H28 x W34 x D15.5cm. Choose from two delightful designs: a whimsical fairy theme or a roaringly fun dinosaur style.
